summary_en: This study is testing stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS) for brain metastases that have spread from small cell lung cancer. SRS is given as radiation, with a dose that may range from 16 to 30 Gy in 1 to 5 treatments, chosen by the radiation oncologist, and participants have a lumbar puncture to collect spinal fluid at enrollment, with an optional repeat at 3 months. The record does not state a main outcome measure; it is a Phase II study described as assessing the efficacy of SRS.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la radiocirugía estereotáctica (SRS) para metástasis cerebrales que se han extendido desde el cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas. La SRS se administra como radiación, con una dosis que puede estar entre 16 y 30 Gy en 1 a 5 tratamientos, según decida el oncólogo radioterapeuta, y los participantes se someten a una punción lumbar para recolectar líquido cefalorraquídeo al inscribirse, con una repetición opcional a los 3 meses. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; es un estudio de Fase II que se describe como una evaluación de la eficacia de la SRS.
who_for: Small cell lung cancer confirmed by tissue examination.
Up to 20 brain metastases seen on contrast-enhanced MRI.
Patient or legal representative able to give informed consent.
not_for: Unable to have contrast-enhanced MRI of the brain.
Leptomeningeal disease confirmed by lumbar puncture, brain MRI, or spine MRI.
Uncontrolled systemic disease with no reasonable treatment options likely to result in death, seen on imaging within 3 months before enrollment.
